user.title: Connect Mealie Planner
user.description:
Enter the Mealie URL reachable from Home Assistant and a Mealie API token (Mealie → your profile → API Tokens). Found Mealie add-on: {detected}.

AI is optional. It reads the shops' printed brochures (once per brochure) and can plan the week. Use the same kind of settings Mealie uses: an OpenAI key, or the address of OpenRouter, Ollama or another OpenAI-compatible service. Without AI the week is planned locally and offers come from the shops' websites only.
